about_the_game:
Overview
In Ping Pan, your goal is simple: get the ping pong ball into the cup. The fun comes from how you do it. You’ll place down pots, pans, and all sorts of everyday objects to create ramps, bouncers, and deflectors that guide the ball along a path of your own design.

Every level starts the same way: a ball launcher fires a ping pong ball into the scene. From there, it’s up to you to build a chain reaction of ricochets and bounces that will carry it safely into the red solo cup. Experiment, adjust, and watch as your setup comes to life—whether it works perfectly or fails in hilarious ways.

You can play through handcrafted levels with unique challenges, or jump into the level editor and design your own puzzles to share with friends. The game is easy to pick up, but endlessly replayable thanks to the freedom of creativity.

How to Play

  • Step 1: Start a level and see where the ball will launch from.

  • Step 2: Place objects like frying pans, sauce pots, plates, and more in the level. Rotate, tilt, or stack them however you like.

  • Step 3: Hit play and watch as the ball bounces off your setup. If it doesn’t make it into the cup, tweak your placement and try again.

  • Step 4: Refine your design until you find the most satisfying solution.

Key Features

  • Creative Gameplay: Solve each puzzle your way using a toolbox of household items.

  • Satisfying Physics: Watch balls bounce, ricochet, and roll with realistic (and sometimes chaotic) physics.

  • Level Editor: Create your own challenges and share them with others.

  • Replayability: Multiple solutions per level encourage creativity and experimentation.

  • Accessible Fun: Easy to learn, quick to play, and hard to put down.

  • Competitive: Come up with ways to beat your friends solutions with the fasted solution, longest path, least/most bounces.
